info.title: NTNU Course Decision API
info.description: Evidence-backed course discovery and detail for student decision-making.

get.description: Returns fast course summaries with explicit enrichment and source status.

post.summary: Enrich visible courses with decision signals
post.description: Returns bounded NTNU course-page assessment, work-form, obligation, collaboration, attendance, and remote-participation signals.

post.summary: Get published NTNU course schedule occurrences for one week
post.description: Returns published activities in the requested Oslo-local ISO week with explicit source availability.

post.summary: Summarize grades for visible NTNU courses
post.description: Returns official DBH/HK-dir grade availability for up to 40 course codes in one request.

get.description: Combines independently sourced course, work-form, assessment, attendance, and grade evidence.
